Touch targets under 48 dp throughout library, reader, settings sheet and TOC
Settings sheet opens with the last row cut at the bottom edge and no scroll affordance
Bookshelf says 2 novels but renders one card with an empty column
No confirmation after import; the new unopened book is marked current reading at 0%
A 60%-read book is labelled «مقروء» (read) instead of in progress
Mixed Latin font/theme labels and an invisible English 'Rewiaty Reader Engine' string in the accessibility tree
First-open hint says a middle tap shows the controls, but the controls are already shown and a middle tap hides them
